payout_quote: Open a new Checking Account - Get $150 ... 1. Open a new checking account between 4/15 – 9/30/2026 using the links below 2. Complete 30 debit transactions within 60 days 3. Log in to Digital Banking within 60 days ... Offer limited to one New Checking Account bonus offer per member up to $150 maximum.
steps: Open a new UICCU checking account between 4/15/2026 and 9/30/2026 using the checking-specific link at https://www.uoficreditunion.org/grad-combo-promo/ (UICCU membership required).
Within 60 days of account opening: complete 30 valid debit card purchase transactions and register for or log in to Digital Banking.
The $150 bonus is paid into the new checking account within 90 days of account opening once all conditions are met; keep the account in good standing.
catches: Must qualify for UICCU membership: University of Illinois student, alumni, or live/work in Champaign, Coles, DeWitt, Douglass, Edgar, Ford, Iroquois, Moultrie, Piatt, Vermilion, Sangamon, or McLean County, Illinois.
Application must be completed using the checking-specific link from the promotional landing page, or the $150 is not paid.
Members who held any UICCU checking account in the last 24 months or received another UICCU checking promotional bonus are not eligible; one New Checking Account bonus per member up to $150.

30 valid debit card purchase transactions within 60 days of account opening; register for or log in to Digital Banking within 60 days; required minimum deposit to open; account in good standing as of payout.
Bonus paid into the new checking account within 90 days of account opening once all qualifying conditions are met; offer available 2026-04-15 through 2026-09-30, may be withdrawn without notice.
Cash bonuses are taxable and reported on IRS 1099-INT.
biggest_catch: Membership is restricted (U of I affiliation or specific Illinois counties), and you must open through the promo link and complete 30 debit purchases within 60 days.
eligibility: UICCU membership required (U of I student/alumni or live/work in listed IL counties); new first-time checking; no UICCU checking in last 24 months; no prior UICCU checking promo; one per member.
timing: Bonus paid into the new checking account within 90 days of account opening once all qualifying conditions are met.
